name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €85/MWh, 14% lower on the week but above the €70 Alert line
state: Dutch TTF gas closed near €85/MWh on 4 Nov, 14% lower on the week on hopes for US–Iran talks but still above the €70 Alert line and 53% higher over three months (Yahoo Finance). Hormuz, the route for Qatari LNG, remained largely shut, with the IRGC claiming mine strikes on tankers south of the strait on 4 Nov (Al Jazeera).
for_you: Wholesale gas prices feed into household energy bills and industrial costs with a lag. In the UK, Ofgem's price cap sets what most households pay.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF gas futures (TTF=F)
Al Jazeera — Iran says US reply to Hormuz plan 'unconvincing'; Trump confirms strikes

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
